items.summary: Unused StationInfo.time_zone/timezone alias remains and is still documented as a configurable option

evidence: station_info.py:23-29 field description says 'Unused' and kept so existing configs keep validating, with a ZoneInfo validator and default_factory.
README.md:150 lists 'timezone = <default: UTC>' and weewx-ha.conf.example:24 suggests setting time_zone; nothing in src reads it.
tests/test_publish.py:30, test_discovery_race.py:50, test_unit_groups.py:109 still pass time_zone='UTC'.
detail.suggestion: Remove the field from README/example config and tests, and either drop it (with extra='forbid' tolerance via an ignored key) or mark it explicitly deprecated with a warning when set.

action_steps.title: Mark the timezone key as accepted-but-ignored in README.md
action_steps.detail: README.md:150 (`timezone = <default: UTC>`, the last line of the [[station]] block at :146-150) is the only place that still mis-advertises the station timezone. Mark that key accepted-but-ignored there, reusing the wording already in the field description at src/weewx_ha/models/station_info.py:25-27 ('Unused. WeeWX timestamps are Unix epochs and are converted straight to UTC...'). Do NOT drop StationInfo.time_zone (src/weewx_ha/models/station_info.py:23-29): HEAD deliberately keeps the field, with alias='timezone' and populate_by_name=True at :16, so existing user configurations still validate -- which is also why the tests that pass time_zone (e.g. tests/test_publish.py:30) are correct as they stand. README text only, no model change.

action_steps.title: Cover ExtensionConfig.from_config_dict on both outcomes
action_steps.detail: LINE CORRECTION: ExtensionConfig.from_config_dict is declared at src/weewx_ha/models/extension_config.py:56-66, but only its BODY, lines 61-66, is uncovered -- the decorator and signature execute at import time. `pipenv run pytest --cov=weewx_ha --cov-report=term-missing` reports that file at 77% with `61-66` missing. Add tests under tests/ for both outcomes: a valid HomeAssistant stanza returns an ExtensionConfig carrying the expected node_id and the METRICWX default from :48-50; an invalid one -- an unknown key suffices, since extra='forbid' is set at :19 -- raises ValidationError out of :65. ASSERTION CORRECTION from the sense-check: do NOT assert 'exactly one logger.error' here. from_config_dict contains exactly one logger.error, at :64, and the controller-init-lifecycle-contract cluster's duplicate-log step decides which of the two reports survives -- make this test assert the count that matches that decision. If the model's log goes, assert zero records from this module and put the single-log assertion in a Controller-level test instead, where the surviving logger.error at src/weewx_ha/controller.py:105-108 fires. Also cover `config_dict.get(key, {})` at :61: a config_dict with no HomeAssistant key must raise rather than silently return defaults.
